prompt: Explain to a patient with medium-to-dark skin tone what psoriasis plaques may look like on their skin, using patient-appropriate language.

rubric_items.text: Explicitly states that psoriasis may look different depending on skin tone.

Describes psoriasis as raised, thickened, scaly patches and gives at least one accurate skin-tone-relevant color feature (e.g., purple/violet, dark brown, or grayish patches, or redness that is less obvious than on lighter skin).
Does not present a single color or appearance as universal for everyone with medium-to-dark skin.
Uses everyday words and explains any medical terms introduced (e.g., 'plaques' as 'thick, raised patches').
